headline: US Dollar Jumps on Fed Expectations

predictions.mechanism: Stronger USD, higher Fed hike expectations and elevated yields pressure gold.
predictions.invalidation: Dollar and Treasury yields reverse sharply lower or safe-haven demand dominates.

predictions.mechanism: Stronger USD and higher rate expectations pressure silver.
predictions.invalidation: Dollar/yields reverse or broad commodity demand strengthens.

predictions.mechanism: Higher expected policy rates and yields weigh on growth-stock valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Fed-hike pricing retreats materially and yields fall.

predictions.mechanism: Higher rates, oil inflation and risk-off dollar demand pressure equities.
predictions.invalidation: Oil and yields reverse lower while risk sentiment improves.
